framework.description: Each criterion is scored 0-10. Multiply by weight. Sum = Composite Score (0-10). Higher is better.

valuation.description: How cheap is the stock on an absolute and relative basis?

score_guide.9-10: Trading at multi-year or historical trough multiples, 40%+ implied upside to DCF/consensus, clear margin of safety
score_guide.7-8: Meaningfully below historical average and peer median, 25-40% implied upside, good margin of safety
score_guide.5-6: Modestly below fair value, 15-25% implied upside, limited but real margin of safety
score_guide.3-4: Near fair value, 5-15% implied upside, minimal margin of safety
score_guide.1-2: At or above fair value, upside depends on multiple expansion that isn't well-supported

key_metrics: Forward P/E vs. sector average and own 5-year average
DCF implied upside using conservative assumptions

balance_sheet.description: Can the company survive and fund itself through the downturn without diluting equity holders?

score_guide.9-10: Net cash position or near-zero net debt, investment grade credit, FCF strongly positive, can self-fund recovery
score_guide.7-8: Low leverage (Net Debt/EBITDA < 1.5x), strong FCF, no near-term debt maturities, investment grade
score_guide.5-6: Moderate leverage (1.5-2.5x), adequate FCF coverage, manageable maturities, investment grade or borderline
score_guide.3-4: Higher leverage (2.5-3.5x), tighter FCF, some debt maturity risk within 2 years, sub-IG possible
score_guide.1-2: Elevated leverage (3.5-4.5x), FCF barely covering interest, maturity wall risk, sub-investment grade
score_guide.0: Distressed balance sheet, refinancing risk, possible covenant breach

catalyst.description: Are there specific, time-bound, identifiable events that could drive a re-rating?

score_guide.9-10: 2+ high-probability catalysts with clear timelines within 12 months, any one of which would likely drive 15%+ move
score_guide.7-8: 1-2 solid catalysts within 12-18 months, reasonable probability, meaningful price impact if hit
score_guide.5-6: Catalysts exist but are either slow-moving (multi-year), lower probability, or smaller magnitude
score_guide.3-4: Vague catalysts without specific triggers or timelines
score_guide.1-2: No clear near-term catalysts; thesis relies on long-term mean reversion only

selloff_quality.description: Is this a high-quality selloff (company-specific, temporary, overreaction) or a low-quality one (structural, justified)?

score_guide.9-10: Classic overreaction — single event caused panic selling, fundamentals intact, market extrapolating worst case
score_guide.7-8: Clear company-specific issue that is largely fixable; some uncertainty remains but core franchise undamaged
score_guide.5-6: Mix of company-specific and structural issues; fixable but will take time and execution
score_guide.3-4: Significant structural headwinds alongside company issues; recovery possible but requires multiple things going right
score_guide.1-2: Primarily structural decline with temporary bounce potential
score_guide.0: Secular decline — the underlying business is being disrupted and won't recover

industry_protection.description: How insulated is the core demand from macro deterioration?

score_guide.9-10: Demand completely inelastic to economic cycles — life-saving drugs, essential utilities, government-contracted defense
score_guide.7-8: Highly defensive — healthcare services/devices, consumer staples with strong brands, critical infrastructure
score_guide.5-6: Mostly defensive with some cyclical exposure — specialty industrials, B2B services with long contracts
score_guide.3-4: Mixed — some defensive demand but meaningful cyclical exposure
score_guide.1-2: Significant cyclical exposure; revenues meaningfully correlated with GDP / consumer health
score_guide.0: Highly cyclical; would be severely impacted by the bear macro scenario

analyst_conviction.description: What does the smart money think, and how confident are they?

score_guide.9-10: Strong buy consensus (75%+ buys), low price target dispersion, recent upgrades from credible banks
score_guide.7-8: Majority buy-rated (55-75%), reasonable target dispersion, stable or improving analyst sentiment
score_guide.5-6: Mixed consensus (40-55% buys), moderate dispersion, some recent downgrades offset by holds
score_guide.3-4: Mostly hold-rated (30-40% buys), high target dispersion, recent downgrade cycle
score_guide.1-2: Weak consensus (< 30% buys), sell ratings present, active downgrade cycle ongoing
score_guide.0: Consensus sell, multiple high-profile downgrades, targets coming down sharply

5.0-6.4.label: SPECULATIVE BUY
5.0-6.4.action: Small position or watchlist; wait for more catalyst clarity

3.0-4.9.label: HOLD / PASS
3.0-4.9.action: Do not initiate; revisit if price declines further
